aggregation.grouping: label, controller, fixed settings terrain height, fixed settings command speed
aggregation.success_rate: sum(successes) / sum(completed episodes), not mean of seed percentages
aggregation.traversals: time and speed weighted by complete geometric traversal count, not samples or successful-episode count; mean speed is not inverse mean time
aggregation.successful_subset: independently pooled completed successful first episodes; no failing-episode samples are included
aggregation.selection: No model ranking, significance claim, or automatic selection is performed

gait_metrics.feet_cross_body_center_definition: signed foot lateral coordinate below zero; distinct from merely being inside the configured positive minimum width
gait_metrics.feet_lateral_definition: foot position relative to root, rotated into full body frame (including roll/pitch), with left +y / right -y positive outward; all gait phases; pair width sums left and right signed lateral positions
gait_metrics.forward_velocity_definition: course_forward_velocity uses world +X (stair ascent direction); body_forward_velocity and forward_velocity_mae use body vx; means weight valid control samples
gait_metrics.hip_abduction_definition: URDF hip angle multiplied by left +1 / right -1; positive is outward; over-limit fraction uses signed angle > maximum, not absolute angle
gait_metrics.hip_outward_component_definition: mean(max(signed hip angle, 0)); unlike signed mean this cannot be reduced by inward angles; adduction fraction separately counts signed angles below zero
gait_metrics.joint_acceleration_definition: finite difference at control step interval
gait_metrics.planar_velocity_mae_definition: mean absolute error across vx and vy components in body frame
gait_metrics.power_definition: mean sum(abs(applied_torque * joint_velocity)), not electrical power
gait_metrics.sampling: pre-step; active environments with episode_length > 1; differences require consecutive valid frames

stairs_lateral_sampling.definition: stairs_ metrics include only valid pre-step frames whose base center is within the stair flight horizontal projection; approach and upper platform excluded; this does not classify individual foot contacts

gait_metrics.stairs_traversal_definition: first complete forward crossing from stair start to end in each episode; boundaries linearly interpolated between consecutive valid pre-step samples; elapsed time includes retreats; one value per completed crossing; spawned-inside, interrupted and incomplete crossings excluded; geometric completion is not episode success

gait_metrics.feet_lateral_definition: foot position relative to root, rotated into full body frame (including roll/pitch), with left +y / right -y positive outward; all gait phases; pair width sums left and right signed lateral positions
gait_metrics.feet_cross_body_center_definition: signed foot lateral coordinate below zero; distinct from merely being inside the configured positive minimum width

stairs_lateral_sampling.definition: stairs_ metrics include only valid pre-step frames whose base center is within the stair flight horizontal projection; approach and upper platform excluded; this does not classify individual foot contacts

gait_metrics_successful_episodes.sampling: pre-step; active environments with episode_length > 1; differences require consecutive valid frames
gait_metrics_successful_episodes.planar_velocity_mae_definition: mean absolute error across vx and vy components in body frame
gait_metrics_successful_episodes.forward_velocity_definition: course_forward_velocity uses world +X (stair ascent direction); body_forward_velocity and forward_velocity_mae use body vx; means weight valid control samples
gait_metrics_successful_episodes.stairs_traversal_definition: first complete forward crossing from stair start to end in each episode; boundaries linearly interpolated between consecutive valid pre-step samples; elapsed time includes retreats; one value per completed crossing; spawned-inside, interrupted and incomplete crossings excluded; geometric completion is not episode success
gait_metrics_successful_episodes.power_definition: mean sum(abs(applied_torque * joint_velocity)), not electrical power
gait_metrics_successful_episodes.joint_acceleration_definition: finite difference at control step interval
gait_metrics_successful_episodes.hip_abduction_definition: URDF hip angle multiplied by left +1 / right -1; positive is outward; over-limit fraction uses signed angle > maximum, not absolute angle
gait_metrics_successful_episodes.hip_outward_component_definition: mean(max(signed hip angle, 0)); unlike signed mean this cannot be reduced by inward angles; adduction fraction separately counts signed angles below zero
gait_metrics_successful_episodes.feet_lateral_definition: foot position relative to root, rotated into full body frame (including roll/pitch), with left +y / right -y positive outward; all gait phases; pair width sums left and right signed lateral positions
gait_metrics_successful_episodes.feet_cross_body_center_definition: signed foot lateral coordinate below zero; distinct from merely being inside the configured positive minimum width

policy_switch.gate: transition_scanner rays in yaw frame x=[-0.45,1.1] m, |y|<=0.30 m; height span enter>0.05 m, exit<0.025 m for 0.4 s; blend 0.3 s in both directions
policy_switch.transition_metric_note: only active environments are counted; completed sequence requires pure walking, pure stairs, then pure walking within one episode, excluding reset frames; a sequence is not itself course success
policy_switch.walk_interface: upstream 49 observations / 16 actions, 50 Hz, dynamic PD gains and 0.1 rad target slew
policy_switch.action_metric_note: manager actions encode executed mixed joint targets in HIM units; raw-action clip metrics are not upstream network clipping metrics
